data.name: Dyna
data.gender_notes: Dyna is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek word dynas meaning power or ability. In Greek mythology, Dynae was a name for a nymph or goddess of power. In the Bible, the name is not explicitly mentioned, but the concept of divine power is a central theme. The name Dyna carries the meaning “Power, Force” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Dyna usually hope their child will grow to embody power, force and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes inner strength, resilience, and determination.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dyna total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
